My teaching page is structured for future instructor-of-record courses, guest lectures, workshops, and student resources.

## Areas Prepared To Teach

- Semiconductor systems, reliability, and lifecycle management
- Systems engineering and complex engineered systems
- AI for engineering systems
- Digital twins and telemetry-driven modeling
- Time-series modeling and uncertainty-aware evaluation
- Robotics, sensing, and autonomous systems foundations

## Mentoring Style

I enjoy helping students connect theory to working systems: clean problem framing, careful evaluation, reproducible experiments, and engineering judgment about where a model can and cannot be trusted.

Future versions of this page can include syllabi, lecture notes, project briefs, and student project showcases.
